headline: Silver Rose 3.7 Percent to $57.60
narrative: Silver rose 3.7 percent to $57.60. The silver pipe is the price of an ounce of silver, and the rise means buyers paid more for the metal. Gold rose 2.06 percent to $4,192.5 on the gold pipe, while oil rose 1.08 percent to $96.12.
author: jordan
